items.meaning: One handled-definition registry bound to its source Definition Pack identity, digest, epoch, handling owner, and handling purpose.
items.absence_behavior: Do not expose the registry as a usable projection.

items.meaning: Every handling disposition preserves original meaning ownership and makes non-promotion custody explicit.
items.absence_behavior: Reject the registry because handling could be mistaken for promotion or authority transfer.

items.meaning: When requested, exact definitions and business-ontology prerequisites and residue are exposed for later DomainSpec construction.
items.absence_behavior: Record a construction-readiness gap; do not claim a compiled graph, system ontology, implementation, or conformance.

owner_routes: Owner of the named intended use
challenge_route: Challenge handling custody through the Define runtime owner, meaning authority through Definitions Governance, and suitability through the next-use owner.
claim_limit: Handling preserves custody and consumer use; it does not promote a definition, transfer ownership, accept a construction handoff, or authorize implementation.
